_about: Public-domain A. R. Fausset (Andrew Robert Fausset, 1821-1910), Canon of York, for the Word Hoard: The Critical and Expository Bible Cyclopaedia (1893), his commentary on Judges (1885), Horae Psalmicae (1885), The Church and the World (1878), A Guide to the Study of the Book of Common Prayer (1903) and the two Old Testament volumes he wrote for the Jamieson-Fausset-Brown Commentary (Job to Isaiah, Jeremiah to Malachi), from Internet Archive scans. Added 2026-10-18 by lane A, round 36 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.

arfausset-bible-cyclopaedia: The Critical and Expository Bible Cyclopaedia, tenth thousand (London: Hodder and Stoughton, 1893)
arfausset-judges: A Critical and Expository Commentary on the Book of Judges (London: James Nisbet, 1885)

arfausset-church-world: The Church and the World (London: Hatchards; York: Pickering, 1878)
arfausset-guide-bcp: A Guide to the Study of the Book of Common Prayer, third and revised edition (London: Chas. J. Thynne, 1903-1904)
arfausset-jfb-3: A Commentary, Critical and Explanatory, on the Old and New Testaments, vol. III, Job to Isaiah, by A. R. Fausset (Philadelphia: J. B. Lippincott; year not read, catalogued 1866)
arfausset-jfb-4: A Commentary, Critical and Explanatory, vol. IV, Jeremiah to Malachi, by A. R. Fausset (Philadelphia: J. B. Lippincott; year not read, catalogued 1866)
